name: anyfile2md
tagline: Convert any file to Markdown - DOCX, PDF, Excel, Images, and 28+ formats
description: A comprehensive document conversion plugin powered by Microsoft's MarkItDown. Convert documents, spreadsheets, presentations, PDFs, images, and data formats to Markdown with a single command or conversational interface.
features: Batch conversion with directory structure preservation
Built-in OCR for scanned documents and images
highlights: Office Documents: DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, PDF
Data Formats: CSV, JSON, XML, YAML, TOML
Images with EXIF extraction and OCR

repository.note: Local repository - not published to public marketplace

demo.description: Convert a PDF to Markdown in seconds

changes: Added MCP server support (STDIO and HTTP modes)
Added batch conversion with directory structure preservation
